user_query: I want to write an article about emerging artists on Soundcloud.

TaskList.description: Gather a list of emerging artists on Soundcloud across the specified genres (indie, electro-pop, and folk).
For each artist gathered, collect background information including their biography, musical style, and notable tracks.
Analyze and summarize the musical styles and influences of the artists.
Compile the information into a cohesive article format.
